author: Pavlo
body:
This is my first map, hope you guys like it :D

-chests contain the following things: 2x Iron sword (Sharpness I), 1x Diamond Sword (Sharpness I, knockback I), 2x diamond sets of armour, 4x bows (Power I, Flame I), XP bottles around enchanting tables.

4 Obbys

Images - http://imgur.com/a/xlaZY
Download - http://www.mediafire.com/download/1lrvo24fit42zzb/Vultus.rar
YML: https://github.com/Flueh/YAML/releases/tag/v1.0

Edited version - Moved obbys further from spawn  - Added spectator spawn - removed blindness
New Obby Location Here
New Map Download Here
New Yaml Here

Update: Added another 2 islands, due to extremely large void gap. Also adds more PvP space
